as_told.title: Hal Puthoff shows up at Chris Bledsoe's door

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes the case of Chris Bledsoe, a man in North Carolina who, Michels says, began attracting UFOs. According to Michels, Hal Puthoff, a long-serving national security figure whom he places at the CIA (the US spy agency) and NASA, showed up at Bledsoe's door once this started. If true, it would mean government-linked people were quietly following ordinary people with UFO experiences.
